f2.question: F2 does nothing
f2.answer: Eclipse opens once you are in the world, not at the login or character screen. Check that `dinput8.dll` sits right next to `Wow.exe`, not in a folder of its own. If you changed the key in Eclipse's settings, press that one.

crash.question: The game crashes while Eclipse loads, or closes as you enter the world
crash.answer: Get the latest Eclipse, which fixed most of these. If it still happens, add `SET dbCompress "0"` to `WTF/Config.wtf` in your game folder.

missing.question: The HD font or some Incarnations are missing
missing.answer: Those need the `Eclipse` folder from Eclipse.zip, next to `Wow.exe` as well. `dinput8.dll` runs on its own, but with fewer features.

names.question: Pieces show file names instead of their real names
names.answer: Real names arrive from the server a moment after a piece first shows. Turn on Settings > Wardrobe > Item caching to load them ahead of time. To find one piece, use `/item` in the Eclipse Discord: it gives the id that the wardrobe's search finds it by.

World.title: World

guide.title: Setup
guide.lead: About two minutes. There is no installer, and nothing is written to the game's own files.

files.title: Put the files beside Wow.exe
files.body: Copy dinput8.dll and the Eclipse folder into your World of Warcraft 3.3.5a folder (build 12340), next to Wow.exe.

start.title: Start the game and press F2
start.body: F2 opens the overlay. You can change the key in its settings.

wear.title: Wear a look from the Community Gallery
wear.body: Copy a code here, open the Loadout page, and press Import. It lights up when your clipboard holds a code, wears the look, and keeps it with your loadouts as Imported.

color.title: Color a place
color.body: Copy a world code from another player, open Colors > World, and press Import. The game jumps to the place the code names.

share.title: Share yours
share.body: Share on the Loadout page, or on any styled place in Colors > World, copies a code. Paste it into Import, on the Loadouts page of the Dressing room, to see what it holds.

guide.syncBody: Turn on the switch on the Multiplayer page. Players with Eclipse on the same realm then see each other's looks through the Eclipse relay. Players without it see your real gear.

travels.slots: Your item slots, including slots you hid

guide.notCarried: It carries no position, movement, combat or chat. The switches on that page choose which parts of your look travel.
guide.stuck: Still stuck? <discord>Ask in the Eclipse Discord</discord>, in the bug reports channel.
guide.removeBody: Delete dinput8.dll and the Eclipse folder. The game goes back to how it was.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: What this website stores, what is public, and how to remove it. Last updated {date}.
privacy.contact: Eclipse is a free fan project. Ask us anything about this page on <discord>Discord</discord>. If this page changes, the date above changes with it. It covers this website; for the game overlay, see the <guide>setup guide</guide>.

points.p1: You do not need an account. The site has no ads and no tracking cookies.
points.p2: We count page views to see which pages are used: the page, the site that linked to it, roughly where in the world it was opened, and the kind of device and browser. Searches, codes and anything else after the page's address are left out. The count uses no cookies, and what tells one visitor from another is thrown away after a day.
points.p3: Our hosting provider handles each request, and that includes your IP address and browser details.
points.p4: When you copy a look's code, we count it once per visitor. We keep only a scrambled fingerprint of your IP address and that look, which cannot be turned back into your address.
points.p5: Your browser remembers that you have seen the support message, and which language you chose.

points.p1: You sign in with Discord. We never see your password.
points.p2: Discord gives us your email address, your name or username, your profile picture and an account ID. Your email address stays private.
points.p3: Your profile picture is public, beside your looks, comments and profile. The picture's address on Discord contains your Discord account ID.
points.p4: Your Discord username is your public name until you change it.
points.p5: Cookies keep you signed in and return you to the page you were on.
points.p6: If you connect Discord roles, we keep a Discord token that can only report your public name, looks and upvotes to the Eclipse server's roles. It ends when you remove the connection in Discord.

points.p1: Linking is optional. A linked game copies your saved loadouts here so you can see them, restore them on another PC and send looks to them.
points.p2: We store each loadout's name, icon, code and pictures, and the character and realm that last synced, with the time. Only your account lists them.
points.p3: Newer versions of the overlay take a picture of a loadout when its look changes and send it here. It can show your character's name and title. Nothing on the site shows it to anyone else until you publish the loadout, but it is stored at a long, random address, and anyone who has that address can open it. Unlinking your game stops new pictures, and removing a loadout deletes its pictures.
points.p4: A loadout becomes public only if you publish it yourself.

points.p1: Once each launch, the game overlay asks this site whether a newer Eclipse is out, linked or not. It sends only its version number.
Your public name and profile picture, any look you publish with its title, description, code, tags and screenshots, and your comments. Anyone can see these without an account.
points.p2: How many votes and copies a look has. Which looks you voted for or copied stays private.
points.p3: Your bookmarks, which only you can see.
points.p4: Any report you send, with its reason. Only moderators see who reported a look.
points.p5: Uploaded screenshots are compressed and their file details are removed, including any location data. Still, avoid uploading anything you would not want public, and remember a screenshot can show your character or account names.

points.p1: Service providers host the website and store accounts, looks and screenshots for us.
points.p2: Discord handles signing in, under its own privacy policy.
points.p3: When a look is reported, moderators get a message on Discord naming the look and the reason, but not who reported it.
points.p4: When you ask a player for a look's code on Discord, the bot says under their post that you asked. We keep a scrambled fingerprint of your Discord account with that post, so that nobody can flood players with requests.
points.p5: Links to downloads, code and donations take you to other sites, which have their own policies.
points.p6: We do not sell your data or use it for advertising.

points.p1: Change your public name at any time, from Settings in your account menu.
points.p2: Delete any look you published, from the look's page. Its screenshots are deleted with it.
points.p3: Unlink a game, or remove any of your saved loadouts, from Loadouts in your account menu.
points.p4: To delete your whole account, ask us on Discord. We keep your data until you delete it or ask us to.
points.p5: Remove a bookmark from the look's page.
points.p6: Moderators can remove looks that break the community's rules, and review every report.
